caption: The drawing depicts a wooden piece of furniture consisting of a chest of drawers with an upper cabinet. The entire furniture piece is rendered in a medium to dark brown color, suggesting a wood finish. The lower section features five drawers arranged vertically, with each drawer having two round knobs symmetrically placed, and the topmost portion of this section contains two smaller drawers side by side. The upper section is a rectangular cabinet that sits on top of the chest, with two doors featuring a total of eight rectangular recessed panels (four on each door). There appears to be a circular decorative element or handle in the center where the two doors meet. The cabinet and chest are supported by four turned legs. There is a small printed text “GEO. V. VEZOLLES” in the lower right corner. The background is plain and light, emphasizing the furniture as the main subject of the drawing.
title: Shaker Cabinet
